title: Changing brains and minds on a changing planet
abstract: Nature Mental Health, Published online: 04 November 2026; doi:10.1038/s44220-026-00763-w Brain health and mental health are shaped by the environments we inhabit. The Earth–Brain–Health Commission argues that climate, ecological and urban transformations are integral to brain health across the lifespan, offering a new framework for uniting neuroscience, psychiatry, public health and environmental science around shared challenges and solutions.
